content.title: SMALL HABITS WITH {{INSTANT}} PAYOFF
facts: **Chew** each bite about 20 times — digestion improves and **bloating** decreases almost immediately.
End your shower with **30-60 seconds of cold water** — circulation gets a boost and alertness spikes right away.
Follow the **20-20-20 rule** (every 20 minutes, look 20 feet away for 20 seconds) — eye strain and tension headaches ease.
**Stand on one leg** while brushing your teeth — balance and core stability quietly improve over weeks.
**Hum or sing** for two minutes a day — it stimulates the vagus nerve and calms the nervous system fast.
Do a few **squats** before sitting for a long stretch — joints stay mobile and blood flow to the legs improves.
